score_contract.score_semantics: masked-language-model logits/embeddings; no official raw SNV VEP contract verified

provenance.notes: Official checkpoint and model card were audited. The published model is a 500M-parameter masked language model with a 2048-token maximum and CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 terms. No official allele-effect scoring routine or GRCh38 forward/reverse raw-score parity was verified; converting masked logits to a pseudo-likelihood would create a different score contract. Deferred by compatibility and license/compute review; no weights were downloaded.
